body:
Interesting case. 
So in this instance the annotations work as expected, but because they do, there are now no suitable nodes in the processing DAG.

I am not really sure how we could handle this in a general way, WDYT @ozangunalp @cescoffier ?

rename.to: IfBuildProfile doesn't work properly with messaging

body: Do you mean that the reactive messaging graph is incomplete? That should be considered as a failure and be reported.
But I still need to check something
Shouldn't you also have channel config conditional to that profile?

So with the configuration above, the application builds fine. However when one runs it, it fails with:

```
SRMSG00230: Unable to create the publisher or subscriber during initialization: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: The attribute `host` on connector 'smallrye-mqtt' (channel: my-data-stream) must be set

```

> Shouldn't you also have channel config conditional to that profile?

So I guess what we are saying here is that the `my-data-stream` channel is now configured a normal input channel?
I think this is looking more like a documentation (and perhaps error message) issue.

What I meant is if these config lines are there, without profiles, the reactive messaging will create channels (`prices` incoming, and `topic-price` outgoing) and try to resolve the graph. It obviously can't, because all beans to be removed with `@IfBuildProfile`. 
If a bean using reactive messaging channels is conditional to the build profile, channel config should be conditional too, as  in:
```
%foo.mp.messaging.outgoing.topic-price...
...
%foo.mp.messaging.incoming.prices...
```
Then both `quarkus dev` and `quarkus dev -Dquarkus.profile=foo` would work as expected.

BTW for configuring the connector it should be `connector=smallrye-mqtt` not `type`. (It works for your case because quarkus discovers that only mqtt is available and configures it for you).

I can confirm that adding the profile to the properties (`%foo.`) makes it work. Yes that should absolutely be documented. 

But it also feels kind of inconsistent:

* The annotations (e.g `@Incoming`) are part of the bean.
* As is the `@IfBuildProfile` annotation, but it covers the whole bean.

So, disabling a bean should IMHO also disable the messaging stuff.

> BTW for configuring the connector it should be `connector=smallrye-mqtt` not `type`. (It works for your case because quarkus discovers that only mqtt is available and configures it for you).

Thanks for the tip, I guess this should be fixed then in the quickstart repo:

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus-quickstarts/blob/496cb69159c59fad207c6bd8b82e4a4667dffc09/mqtt-quickstart/src/main/resources/application.properties#L3-L15
@ctron but the quickstart does not use `@IfBuildProfile`. I think, we should just document that in the reactive messaging reference guide.
